title: Reveries V2 ledger envelope manifest (RVR-005)
description: The manifest.json a refs/heads/reveries-ledger checkpoint stores. It is not a note record: it describes the notes boundary rather than living inside it. It carries no timestamp so a checkpoint rebuilt from the same evidence reproduces the same object ID; RVR-009 signs these canonical bytes.

notes_commit.description: The exact notes commit transported as a typed parent. Null exactly when notes_tree is null.

notes_tree.description: The notes tree OID grafted at the ledger notes entry. The verifier compares it against the real tree entry, which is what detects a graft swap. Null exactly when notes_commit is null.

previous_ledger.description: The previous ledger checkpoint; the first parent, which makes every update a fast-forward. Null only on a genesis checkpoint.

retention_commit.description: The retention checkpoint this ledger anchors; the optional third parent. Null when no retention vault exists.

authority.description: Reserved for RVR-017 authority roles. Exactly one documented value today: the configured primary remote name. Shape-validated as a single trimmed token with no whitespace or control characters; null when none is configured.
